content: We got many templates. Need one that corresponds to SN2: breaking halide, forming C-N (amine). The functional groups broken: halide; formed: amine (primary/secondary/tertiary). The search gave many results but we need appropriate template. Look at first result: retro_smarts_template shows [#7;a:7]-[C:6]-[c:5]... seems not SN2. Need template where C-X (halide) broken and C-N formed. Could search again with functional_groups_broken ["alkyl halide"] and functional_groups_formed ["primary amines"] maybe.
